يستمعا (form VIII)
# يَسْتَمِعَا (yastamiʕā) /jas.ta.mi.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
# يُسْتَمَعَا (yustamaʕā) /jus.ta.ma.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَمَعَ (istamaʕa)
